# routeros_system_ptp (Resource)




<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the PTP instance.

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `comment` (String)
- `delay_mode` (String) The delay measurement mechanism.
  * auto - selected by the profile;
  * e2e - end-to-end (delay request-response);
  * p2p - peer-to-peer (peer delay).
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `domain` (String) The PTP domain number, used to separate different PTP instances in the same network. An integer `0..127`, or `auto` to take the value from the profile.
- `priority1` (String) The first grandmaster election parameter, an integer `0..255` (lower wins), or `auto` to take the value from the profile.
- `priority2` (String) The second grandmaster election parameter used to break ties, an integer `0..255` (lower wins), or `auto` to take the value from the profile.
- `profile` (String) The PTP profile. Each profile comes with its own predefined `auto` values for the PTP operating parameters.
  * 802.1as;
  * aes67;
  * default;
  * g8275.1;
  * smpte-2059.
- `transport` (String) The transport used to carry the PTP messages.
  * auto - selected by the profile;
  * ipv4 - UDP over IPv4;
  * l2-forwardable - Ethernet, forwardable multicast address;
  * l2-non-forwardable - Ethernet, link-local multicast address.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `inactive` (Boolean)
